source.title: 2019 American College of Rheumatology/Arthritis Foundation Guideline for the Management of Osteoarthritis of the Hand, Hip, and Knee
source.whyItFits: Open ACR/Arthritis Foundation osteoarthritis guideline with graded recommendations for exercise and topical and oral NSAIDs across hand, hip, and knee disease.
